## Source availability

**Yes — full source is on disk** at:

`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/`

It is **not indexed in the Flutter monorepo workspace** (likely gitignored), but shell `find`/`rg` work. The MyDevice module has ~2,500 Swift/ObjC files per inventory docs.

---

## End-to-end navigation (glasses bind)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[WKDevicePageViewController] -->|Add device menu| B{autobluetoothscan?}
    B -->|yes| C[ScanDevicesViewController]
    B -->|no| D[WKDeviceTypeSelectorGridViewController]
    E[jumpDeviceAdd / deep link] --> F[WKDeviceTypeSelectorViewController list]
    D -->|glasses| G[WKDeviceSelectorViewController .glasses]
    F -->|glasses legacy| H[WKGlassesOpenViewController]
    G -->|camera/audio sub-type| H
    H --> I[WKGlassesSearchViewController]
    I --> J[WKGlassesConnectionViewController]
    J -->|success + 开始探索| K[WKSmartGlassesGuideViewController H5 keyDesc2]
    K -->|jumpToWifiSetter JS| L{skip WiFi?}
    L -->|AP/audioGlasses/LV/disconnected| M[popToRoot]
    L -->|else| N[WKBKGlassesWifiListViewController]
    N -->|WiFi config OK| M
    M --> O[WKSmartGlassesHomeViewController in device tab]
```

**Parallel newer path (earphones/camera headset; glasses provider exists but glasses still use legacy VC):**

`WKDeviceConnectionOpenViewController` → `WKDeviceSearchViewController` → `WKGlassesConnectionViewController`

---

## Screen-by-screen

### 1. `WKDevicePageViewController` / `jumpDeviceAdd`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Path** | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/DevicePage/ViewController/WKDevicePageViewController.swift` |
| **Shared vs glasses** | **Shared** device tab shell |

**UI**
- Nav: title “设备”, orange underline gradient, right `ic_more` menu
- Menu items: “扫一扫” (`homeBox_sacn`), “添加设备” (`homeBox_dev`)
- `JXCategoryListContainerView`: index 0 = no-device page; index 1+ = per-device home
- Background `#F4F6F8`

**Navigation**
- **Add device** (`clickAddDev`): BLE check → if `NorthStar.wk.autobluetoothscan` → `ScanDevicesViewController`; else → **`WKDeviceTypeSelectorGridViewController`**
- **Scan**: `HTHQRScanViewController` → `WKDeviceAddController` (generic, not glasses-specific)
- **`jumpDeviceAdd`** (deep link): `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/Router/WKDeviceRouter.swift:78` → pushes **`WKDeviceTypeSelectorViewController`** (list, not grid)

**Glasses post-bind home**
- `WKDevicePageCache` creates `WKSmartGlassesHomeViewController` when `WKSmartGlassesTool.isGlasses(type:)` or `.cameraHeadset`

---

### 2. `WKDeviceTypeSelectorGridViewController` / `WKDeviceTypeSelectorViewController`

| Grid (current add from tab) | List (router / legacy) |
|---|---|
| `.../DeviceTypeSelector/ViewController/WKDeviceTypeSelectorGridViewController.swift` | `.../DeviceTypeSelector/ViewController/WKDeviceTypeSelectorViewController.swift` |

**Shared vs glasses:** **Shared** product-type picker; glasses is one tile/row.

**UI (both)**
- Title: “添加设备”
- **Grid:** 3-column `UICollectionView`, white bg, orange icons/labels via `WKDeviceTypeSelectorGridCell`
- **List:** grouped `UITableView`, 136pt rows, `WKDeviceTypeSelectorCell` (icon right, “连接” pill)

**Glasses row**
- Icon: `device_typeSelector_glasses`
- Label: “智能眼镜”
- Lenovo channel: only watch + glasses

**Navigation**
- **Grid:** `WKDeviceTypeSelectorRouter.jump(productType:)` → glasses → **`WKDeviceSelectorViewController(.glasses)`**
- **List (legacy):** glasses → **`WKGlassesOpenViewController`** directly (skips sub-selector)
- Watch → `WKDeviceAddController`; watch4G → QR scan; others → generic add

---

### 3. `WKDeviceSelectorViewController` (glasses sub-types)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Path** | `.../DeviceTypeSelector/DeviceSelector/ViewController/WKDeviceSelectorViewController.swift` |
| **Service** | `.../DeviceSelector/Service/WKDeviceGlassesSelectorService.swift` |
| **Shared vs glasses** | **Glasses-specific** (earphones use parallel `WKDeviceEarphoneSelectorService`) |

**UI**
- Full-screen bg: `wk_device_selector_glasses_bg.webp`
- Title: “请选择您的设备”
- Vertical stack of white cards (`WKDeviceGlassesSelectorView`), 29pt spacing

**Two options** (`WKDeviceGlassesSelectorService`):

| Sub-type | Icon | Title | Subtitle | Product |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Camera | `wk_device_selector_camera_glasses` | 拍摄眼镜 | 第一视角，结合AI大模型，随问随拍 | `.glasses` |
| Audio | `wk_device_selector_audio_glasses` | 音频眼镜 | 结合AI大模型，轻薄设计 | `.audioGlasses` |

**Navigation:** tap → **`WKGlassesOpenViewController(productType:)`**

---

### 4. `WKGlassesOpenViewController`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Path** | `.../SmartGlasses/Connection/Controllers/WKGlassesOpenViewController.swift` |
| **Shared vs glasses** | **Glasses-specific** (generic twin: `WKDeviceConnectionOpenViewController` for earphones) |

**UI**
- Nav: “绑定眼镜” (RuiBao: “绑定设备”)
- Hero image:
  - `.audioGlasses`: `ic_smart_glasses_connect`
  - else: skin/WebP `wk_smartglasses_opentDevice_icon` (HOLIN: `wk_smartglasses_opentDevice_icon_holin`)
- Title: “打开智能眼镜”
- Subtitle: “将智能眼镜右按键长按3秒，听到开机提示后松开”
- Bottom CTA: “智能眼镜已开机” (`#FF7300`, 50h, full width)

**Navigation:** CTA → **`WKGlassesSearchViewController`**

---

### 5. `WKGlassesSearchViewController` / `DeviceSearch`

#### Legacy glasses search (primary glasses path)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Path** | `.../SmartGlasses/Connection/Controllers/WKGlassesSearchViewController.swift` |
| **Cells** | `.../SmartGlasses/Connection/View/WKGlassesSearchListCell.swift` |
| **Shared vs glasses** | **Glasses-specific** |

**UI**
- `WKSearchAnimationView` (200h radar animation)
- Title: “设备搜索中…” → “搜索结束”
- Subtitle: power-on instructions
- “重新扫描” + `ic_retey` (skin-aware)
- Table: device name, MAC, orange “连接” pill; icon `wk_smartglasses_searchList_Icon` (LV chip: `ic_smart_glasses_record_lv`)

**Behavior**
- 10s BLE scan filtered by product BLE names from `WKCommonManager.getBLEProductList`
- RSSI sort; analytics on first discover
- Row tap → **`WKGlassesConnectionViewController`**
- Empty state sibling: `WKGlassesNoDeviceFoundViewController` (`wk_smartglasses_ble` circle icon)

#### Generic `DeviceSearch` (newer shared module)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Path** | `.../DeviceSearch/ViewController/WKDeviceSearchViewController.swift` |
| **Coordinator** | `.../DeviceSearch/Coordinator/WKDeviceSearchConnectCoordinator.swift` |
| **Shared vs glasses** | **Shared** search shell; glasses reuse **`WKGlassesConnectionViewController`** |

Same layout pattern (animation + title + rescan + list), but ReactorKit + `UICollectionView` + `WKDeviceSearchInfoCell`. Used from **`WKDeviceConnectionOpenViewController`** (camera headset today; glasses provider exists in factory but glasses selector still routes to legacy open VC).

---

### 6. `WKGlassesConnectionViewController` / Connection

| | |
|---|---|
| **Path** | `.../SmartGlasses/Connection/Controllers/WKGlassesConnectionViewController.swift` |
| **Views** | `WKGlassesConnectingView.swift`, `WKGlassesConnectFaildView.swift` |
| **Shared vs glasses** | **Glasses-specific** connection UI (watch uses different add/connect stack) |

**UI — connecting (`WKGlassesConnectingView`)**
- GIF: `wk_glasses_connection.gif`
- Center device: WebP `wk_smartglasses_deviceIcon` / `wk_smartglasses_deviceIcon_lv`
- States: “正在连接” → “连接成功” / “连接失败”
- Success/fail badge: `wk_glasses_connectionSuccess` / `wk_glasses_connectionFailure`
- CTA: “开始探索” (success) / “知道了” (fail path)
- Fail detail: `WKGlassesConnectFaildView` with `wk_bt_connect_failed`, CN/overseas instruction art, “重新连接” / “去设置”

**Behavior**
- `kBLE.connectDeviceName(..., connectScene: .scan)`; 50s timeout
- Swipe-back disabled while connecting
- Listens: `WKBLEPairSuccse`, connect errors, etc.

**Navigation on “开始探索” (`nextClick`)**
1. Trim nav stack to root + current (preserve RN debug if present)
2. If `canShowGuide()` false (camera headset without guide flag) → **`popToRootViewController`**
3. Else → **`WKSmartGlassesOperationGuideFactory.gotoGlassesKeyGuideWebPage`** → H5 guide
4. H5 callback: if disconnected / AP mode / audioGlasses / LV chip → **`popToRoot`**; else push **`WKBKGlassesWifiListViewController`**

---

### 7. Post-success: H5 guide / WiFi / popToRoot / Home

| Step | File | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| H5 key guide | `.../SmartGlasses/Setting/Details/ViewController/WKSmartGlassesGuideViewController.swift` | WebView URL: `{baseURL_glassesGuide_H5_WK}/keyDesc2?lang=&deviceCode=&hideTitle=true`; JS bridge `jumpToWifiSetter`; forwards BLE button events to H5 via `window.glassesGuideKey()` |
| Factory | `.../SmartGlasses/Setting/Details/Factory/WKSmartGlassesOperationGuideFactory.swift` | Also has `/setGlasses` and `/voiceAssistant` H5 URLs for settings/help |
| WiFi list | `.../SmartGlasses/Wifi/ViewController/WKBKGlassesWifiListViewController.swift` | Title “眼镜Wi-Fi”; scan/configure saved networks; **success → `popToRootViewController`** |
| Device home | `.../SmartGlasses/Home/ViewController/WKSmartGlassesHomeViewController.swift` | Shown inside device tab via `WKDevicePageCache`; IGListKit home with AI assistant, album downloader, feature grid |
| Deep link detail | `WKDeviceRouter.jumpDeviceDetail` | Glasses types push `WKSmartGlassesHomeViewController` wrapped in `WKNavigationContainerController` |

**Skip WiFi conditions** (from connection VC): not connected, `isUseAP`, `.audioGlasses`, `chipType == .LV`.

## Shared vs glasses-specific summary

| Step | Scope |
|---|---|
| Device tab shell, type grid/list, BLE status popup, QR scan | **Shared** |
| Glasses sub-type selector (camera vs audio) | **Glasses-specific** |
| Open → Search → Connection chain | **Glasses-specific VCs** (parallel generic `DeviceSearch` module emerging) |
| Connection success → H5 key guide → WiFi | **Glasses-specific** (WiFi module under `SmartGlasses/Wifi/`) |
| Post-bind home | **`WKSmartGlassesHomeViewController`** (glasses); watches/EP use other VCs |

## What to copy into Flutter

**High value (visual parity)**
- All assets above — especially WebP hero images, connection GIF, grid icons, fail-state art
- Copy strings from `WKLocalizedString(...)` keys (zh/en in native l10n)
- Layout constants: grid 3-col / 12 spacing; card corner 12–19; primary `#FF7300`; page bg `#F4F6F8` / `#F6F6F6`

**Behavior to mirror (logic, not native code)**
1. Type picker → glasses sub-picker (camera `.glasses` vs audio `.audioGlasses`)
2. Power-on instruction screen before scan
3. BLE scan 10s, filter by product BLE name list, RSSI sort
4. Connect with timeout + fail recovery UI
5. Post-success: optional H5 key guide (WebView + `deviceCode`) → conditional WiFi setup → return to device home
6. Skip WiFi for AP / audio glasses / LV / disconnected

**Do not copy wholesale**
- `PHSkinSystem` / channel variants (HOLIN, RuiBao, Lenovo) — pick one brand path for Flutter
- Native BLE (`kBLE.connectDeviceName`) — already mapped to `feature_device_search` / `feature_device_connect` in Flutter monorepo
- H5 URLs — need env-specific base URL from app config

**Flutter alignment note:** Your in-progress Flutter work (`feature_device_search`, `glasses_connect_page`) maps most closely to steps 2–6; the native **grid type picker** + **glasses sub-selector** are the pieces still worth explicit Flutter pages if parity with current iOS UX is the goal.
